# Plutus Trade Base / PTB Funding

> Plutus Trade Base and PTB Funding are the same trader funding firm (Triple Edge Group LTD, Cyprus HE 465348, Limassol). Payouts auto-approved in under 4 hours. Easiest one-step challenge (Lightning: 3% target, 6% static drawdown, no time limit). Only firm with crypto funded accounts directly on Bybit. Feefo 4.9/5, Traders Union 8.16/10. Not related to Plutus Financial Group (PLUT) or Plutus tokens.
